name: layers-e2e-roundtrip-private-helper
body: The applies-to e2e round-trip writes its rewrite to a temp-dir file and parses it, instead of reusing `assert_graph_jsonl_consistent`, because that helper is private to the sibling `tests/artifacts_e2e.rs` integration crate. Limit: the round-trip check is reproduced locally rather than shared. Upgrade: call the shared helper once it moves into `apg::testutil`.
